title: trisetum spicatum subsp. alaskanum
intro: Trisetum spicatum subsp. alaskanum, commonly known as Alaskan Needlegrass, is a subspecies of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Alaskan Needlegrass are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids that have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and antiproliferative activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Trisetum spicatum subsp. alaskanum, but it has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat a range of health issues.
